) co-founder
Bill Gates
said in an interview on Friday that he would never use cryptocurrencies to diversify away from the dollar.
‘Mania-Driven Asset’

During an interview with APT News, Gates was asked if he were “forced” to move a small part of his portfolio out of the dollar, what would he choose: the euro, the Chinese yuan, gold, or cryptocurrency
The tech tzar was quick to reply, “I wouldn’t choose crypto,” adding that he’s a well-known skeptic of “pure mania-driven assets.”
If Not Crypto, Then What?
Turning to other assets, Gates said he had missed the gold rally and predicted that the euro would not rise significantly.
“I think a basket of equities in general is your best long-term. Ideally, a globally balanced basket of equities,” stated Gates, who was the world’s richest individual for many years.
